worstDefects.defect: Temporal shimmer / edge crawl in every clip (cloudy 6.36, bridge-low 5.95, harbor 5.71 mean |diff|): tree cards, container edges, water depth blocks and cables crawl frame to frame; hard failures in cloudy, harbor and cockpit-city (category 20).
worstDefects.function: QUALITY presets (low: samples 0) used by PostPipeline in render/post.ts (sceneRT created with samples: opts.samples), selected by bench/scripts/capture.mjs (clipQuality default 'low'); the renderer itself is created with antialias: false so nothing supplies AA when samples is 0
worstDefects.fix: Give the low preset 2x MSAA or add a temporal/FXAA resolve in PostPipeline.finish(); capture the clip at the same quality as the still so the two artefacts agree.

worstDefects.defect: Propeller blur disc sorts over geometry it should be behind: a ~600 px translucent arc across the whole windshield in cockpit-city (D4-F4) and a ring visible through the cabin roof in harbor (E5) and bridge-low/island-pass cockpits (category 25 hard failures in cockpit-city and harbor).
worstDefects.function: constructor propDisc setup (MeshStandardMaterial transparent, depthWrite false, renderOrder 15, CircleGeometry radius 1.5 on the propeller at x 4.62) and animate() (disc.opacity = 0.42 * blend): from cockpitEye (1.0, 0.93, -0.30) the 3 m disc is 3.6 m ahead and 0.9 m below eye level, so its tip ring subtends ~45 deg of the 62 deg FOV and crosses the whole windshield as a 600 px arc; with renderOrder 15 and depthWrite false it is drawn after the cabin and composites over the cowl and roof wherever the log-depth test lets it through
worstDefects.fix: Hide propDisc when the camera is inside the cabin (cockpit view) or clip it to the windshield frame; for chase views set renderOrder below the cabin glass and enable depthTest against the fuselage so the ring is occluded by the cowl.

worstDefects.defect: Triangle budget: cloudy flight frame 1.761 M triangles (main pass 1.30 M) exceeds the 1.5 M budget by 17 %, with night still at 1.498 M and cockpit-city still at 1.480 M; the night shadow pass still submits 327 k triangles over 3 cascades for moonlight (category 27).
worstDefects.function: Vegetation.updateLod(): the 3D crown tiles inside NEAR_DISTANCE (420 m) are spent nearest-first up to NEAR_BUDGET (60 000 instances) with ULTRA/HI tessellation by cell distance; over the coastal forest in cloudy at 300 m altitude the whole budget is in view, and Game.render() (src/game.ts) does not lower the budget or the cascade count when the frame is already over the triangle limit
worstDefects.fix: Scale NEAR_BUDGET by the previous frame's main-pass triangle count (drop to 40 000 above 1.2 M), and in Game.render() drop to 2 cascades / halve vegetation.shadowDistance when atmos.state.sunIntensity is the moon value.

otherAttributedDefects.defect: Moored aircraft telemetry: RPM rises 600 -> 758 with throttle 0 % and the heading drifts 2.8 deg over the 3 s clip in plane-rear-quarter, plane-front-quarter and glass-sun (category 21).
otherAttributedDefects.function: Aircraft.place() seeds flight.rpm = throttle (0) instead of the idle value, then FlightModel.substep() ramps rpm toward target * 0.92 + 0.08 with a 0.7 s lag (HUD shows 600 + rpm * 2000), so the tachometer climbs to idle during the clip; the yaw drift is the weathervane/turbulence yaw moment in substep() acting on a floating aircraft with the water rudders centred.
otherAttributedDefects.fix: Seed rpm = throttle * 0.92 + 0.08 in place(); damp the yaw moment on water when |V| < 2 m/s (or apply a mooring constraint for the static views).

otherAttributedDefects.defect: Water-landing touchdown: altitude drops 3.3 m between clip frames 10 and 20 (5.5 -> 2.1 m) with alpha 0.010 -> 0.117 and the frozen HUD shows V/S +400 while the aircraft descends (categories 20/21).
otherAttributedDefects.function: bench/views.ts water-landing spec (pos y 5.5, speed 29, throttle 0.25, flaps 1, pitch 4 deg, presim 30) leaves the aircraft at 25.8 m/s with alpha rising to 0.117 rad, so FlightModel.substep() lets it balloon (velocity.y > 0 at the still, HUD V/S = verticalSpeed * 196.85 -> +400) and then sink 3.3 m in 1 s onto the floats; updateTelemetry() reports the raw velocity.y so the HUD and the visible descent disagree.
otherAttributedDefects.fix: Start the water-landing view at 2.5 m with speed 32 and a -0.5 m/s sink (or hold pitch with the presim autopilot) so the clip shows a flare, and add a buoyancy ramp over the float depth in substep() so touchdown is not a 3 m/s drop.

otherAttributedDefects.defect: Aircraft shadow bands on the water (plane-rear-quarter A6-H8, glass-sun D7-H8) are geometrically correct planform shadows but have ruler-straight edges and a flat single-tone interior with no bed texture (category 17).
otherAttributedDefects.function: WATER_FRAG_COMPOSE: shadow = directDiffuse / unshadowed and Ebody = indirect + mix(directDiffuse, unsh, volumeLeak) scale the whole body term with the CSM shadow sampled at the flat surface point; the wave slope is never applied to the shadow lookup and the bed albedo variation is scaled away under shadow.
otherAttributedDefects.fix: Offset the shadow lookup by the refracted wave slope (a few cm per unit slope) and keep the bed albedo variation under shadow (scale only the direct term).

otherAttributedDefects.defect: Mirror reflections of tall objects (bridge-low tower C4-D5, island-pass hotels A5-B5, water-landing shore A3-D3) are rendered and composited at the correct position but blurred to under 5 levels of contrast, so they read as missing (category 10). Confirmed by forcing the mirror texture red: coverage appears exactly under the towers.
otherAttributedDefects.function: sceneReflection(): streak = uReflTune.x * sqrt(mss) * share * focal and lod = log2(max(across, 0.375 * streak)) clamped to uReflParams.w (6) selects mip levels up to 1/64 resolution for any object whose mirrored path share approaches 1, which merges the tower legs and facades into the surrounding sky texels.
otherAttributedDefects.fix: Clamp lod to 2 for objects taller than ~20 m within 600 m, or scale the streak by the object's mirrored height so tall structures keep their vertical edges.

technicalReport.methodNotes: Debug captures under /tmp/critictech (dbgcap.mjs, dbgprobe*.mjs) used the bench URL with freeze=1 and dbg=noshadow/norefl/cascades/reflview plus per-mesh castShadow isolation, WATER_DEBUG irradiance, uReflTune sweeps and a red-mask resolve to verify shadow and reflection findings before scoring. Note the dbg=reflview blit is horizontally mirrored relative to the screen (the mirror camera has flipped handedness), which is why the deck appeared displaced in the debug texture; the water samples it through uReflVP so the composite is correct.
